OPERATOR-ATTESTED CANARY EVIDENCE (RP-04 post-cutover) — session d83fb4f6fd, run 2026-08-19 (America/Los_Angeles).

Canary set: AWS review-bot + reconciler check/dry-run/bounded-live, verifying no credential leakage and no unauthorized fallback after the LLM/git/bridge composition cutover.

1) AWS review-bot (hosted, live). Cast LLM-Review +1 (PASS) this session on Gerrit changes 1905, 1902, 1901. Auth-source kind: hosted AWS review-bot service credentials (op-cert startup path). Retry count: 0. Redacted outcome: all three changes reached LLM-Review +1; no fallback to an anonymous/alternate principal; no credential value surfaced in votes or comments.

2) Reconciler check (live). `bridge check-access` against live Jira project REB. Auth-source kind: JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN (Cloud API token). Probe steps: create, label-write, property-write, JQL-search, property-read, delete — all PROBE_PASS on the second run (first run had a single JQL index-lag miss on the search step, expected eventual-consistency, no auth failure). Redacted outcome: round-trip succeeded; token never logged; fail-closed on missing project confirmed.

3) Reconciler dry-run / live pass (hosted). `bridge status` reported FOREIGN pass=2026-08-19T16:34:03 environment=reconciler; `bridge fsck` = "No issues found" over the healthy REB binding set. Auth-source kind: hosted reconciler service credentials. Retry count: 0. Redacted outcome: live hosted reconciler pass witnessed; no unauthorized fallback.

4) Bounded-live provider. review-plan executed this session via provider bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8 (auth-source kind: AWS Bedrock, one-run/one-Agent request budget). Verdicts PASS on 3199, aabf, e215. Retry count: 0; no cross-provider or anonymous fallback; no credential leakage in artifacts/traces.

Secret handling: no credential value or filesystem path to a credential was recorded in any of the above. Rollback decision: none required — all canaries passed; legacy facades stay removed (retain S1 snapshot-envelope compatibility floor).
